U1506.title: TCAN3403DDFRQ1 +-58 V CAN Transceiver
U1506.summary: Replaced TCAN330 (+-14 V abs max) with TCAN3403-Q1 (+-58 V bus fault, pin 5 VIO moved to +3V3_D, STB low): survives 12-24 V battery/jump-start shorts with 1890 mA +3V3_D rail inside 3.0-3.6 V.

U1002.title: +3V3_D TPS563201 (3 A) Buck
U1002.summary: Upgraded from 2 A TPS562201 (89-95% use) to pin-compatible 3 A TPS563201: 1778 mA typ / 1890 mA worst (63% use, 0.693 W dissipation).

U1006.title: +1V8_D LDO Set to 1.85 V
U1006.summary: Pin 5 ANY-OUT grounded to raise +1V8_D to 1.85 V: XC7A50T VCCAUX reaches 1.714-1.873 V at balls (spec 1.71-1.89 V); carries 629 mA (0.912 W worst, 1.265 V headroom).

U1315.title: +2V8_RF LP5907MFX-2.8 LDO
U1315.summary: Renamed +3V0_RF to +2V8_RF (LP5907MFX-2.8): worst-case headroom rises from 26 mV to 232 mV vs 180 mV dropout; RFFC5072 sees 2.701-2.889 V (180 mA, 72% use).

F1001.title: mSMD200-24V 2.0 A Hold PTC
F1001.summary: Upgraded from 1.5 A hold (tripped >56 C) to 2.0 A hold: worst input 1116 mA (13.4 W) trips only above 83.9 C @ 12 V and 73.1 C @ 10.5 V; typical (85+ C) never trips.

C1441.title: HP300 11 pF Series Input Cap (Frame A)
C1441.summary: Preselector B 300 MHz 5th-order elliptic high-pass (0402 C0G): <=1.13 dB nom (1.51 dB p99) 300 MHz-3 GHz, RL 12.7 dB (10.7 dB p1), >=52.8 dB (51.7 dB p1) <=175 MHz; IF rej 31-46 -> 84-99 dB.

L1441.title: HP300 24 nH Shunt Inductor 1 (Frame A)
L1441.summary: Shunt trap branch 1 with C1442 (36 pF) in preselector B 300 MHz high-pass (0402 LQW15AN, 3,000-board MC): <=1.13 dB passband, >=51.7 dB p1 rejection <=175 MHz; IF rej 31-46 -> 84-99 dB.

C1442.title: HP300 36 pF Shunt Capacitor 1 (Frame A)
C1442.summary: Shunt trap branch 1 with L1441 (24 nH) in preselector B 300 MHz high-pass (0402 C0G): <=1.13 dB (1.51 dB p99) passband, >=51.7 dB p1 stopband <=175 MHz; IF rej 31-46 -> 84-99 dB.

C1443.title: HP300 5.6 pF Series Mid Cap (Frame A)
C1443.summary: Center series 0402 C0G capacitor of the preselector B 300 MHz high-pass between L1441/C1442 and L1442/C1444: <=1.51 dB p99 above 300 MHz, 10.7 dB p1 RL, IF rej 31-46 -> 84-99 dB.

L1442.title: HP300 22 nH Shunt Inductor 2 (Frame A)
L1442.summary: Shunt trap branch 2 with C1444 (91 pF) in preselector B 300 MHz high-pass (0402 LQW15AN): suppresses 88-170 MHz by 53.4-70.3 dB (51.7 dB p1 <=175 MHz), lifting IF rej from 31-46 to 84-99 dB.

C1444.title: HP300 91 pF Shunt Capacitor 2 (Frame A)
C1444.summary: Shunt trap branch 2 with L1442 (22 nH) in preselector B 300 MHz high-pass (0402 C0G): suppresses FM/airband/VHF <=170 MHz by >=53.4 dB nominal (>=51.7 dB p1 <=175 MHz).

C1445.title: HP300 8.2 pF Series Output Cap to VU_PSB_HP
C1445.summary: Output series 0402 C0G capacitor feeding preselector B switches (VU_PSB_HP): <=1.13 dB nom (1.51 dB p99) 300 MHz-3 GHz, RL 12.7 dB (10.7 dB p1), IF rej 31-46 -> 84-99 dB.

J1102.title: Pmod Header Back-Powering Gate (Both FPGAs)
J1102.summary: Gateware gating eliminates up to 108 mA Pmod back-powering (8x 0-ohm lines -> 0.0 mA built): Artix gates PMOD_MISO on kria_present & makes PMOD_SPARE2 open-drain; K26 holds outputs high-Z until adapter_alive.

J961.title: VHF/UHF SMA Input (30-170 MHz & 300 MHz-3 GHz)
J961.summary: Direct 30-170 MHz, converted 300 MHz-3 GHz (170-300 MHz not covered due to 135 MHz IF + HP300); AP22652 bias tee limits 5 V short to 95-155 mA (FB1302 250 mA / L1301 170 mA safe); prefer JP1301 3.3 V; external limiter for co-sited TX (+25 dBm LNA abs max).
